name: free-audit-form
title: Free audit form
description: Trade a website address for a free review: URL and email, a validated check and a confirmation that says when the report arrives.
docs: Pass onSubmit, which receives the tidied address and the work email, plus a title, a description, the points the audit covers, the turnaround ('Report within 24 hours') and the consent line, which may hold a link. The address is tidied as the visitor leaves the field: https is added, the host is lower-cased and everything after the site is dropped, so the field shows exactly what is sent; set keepPath to keep a path such as /pricing. A mistake is said in plain words beside its field once the visitor has been there or tried to send, and the first one takes focus; pressing the button never loses its click to a message that appears on the way. The confirmation replaces the form, lists what was received, repeats the turnaround and takes focus so a screen reader reads it. On a wide screen the form sits beside the heading and the points; on a phone the form follows the heading and the points come after it. defaultValues and defaultStatus start it filled or confirmed. labels translates every fixed word.
